messages:
maria (ml): thinking about transactional warmup gatekeeping for safetensors bundles. want to avoid partial activation if some shards fail / evict

jon (runtime): agree. partial activation currently causes OOM cascades. tx-id based activation sounds good

kevin (eng-ml): concern: long warmups hold pages. need ability to fall back to smaller quantized variant during prepare

samantha (infra): implementation idea: each shard writes to staging path `.staged/<txid>/<shard>` then atomic rename to live when all present. also compute sha256 on write

maria (ml): loader API proposal:
```
prepare(txid, shard_meta) -> token
commit(txid)
abort(txid)
on_eviction_during_prepare(txid, shard_id) -> abort or retry
```

jon (runtime): +1. expose a prepare timeout and a prioritization hint. metrics: warmup_duration_ms, warmup_tx_aborts, staged_bytes

kevin (eng-ml): how do we coordinate with eviction? if eviction removes files during prepare we should hold a lightweight lease on pagecache or increment refcount

samantha (infra): lease approach ok. Another option: optimistic namespace: each prepare writes with uuid and only rename if manifest patch succeeds. manifest patch is single atomic op in weight-registry

maria (ml): compatibility note: safetensors streaming loader must support staged write path; for mmap path we can write into temp file and `mmap` once committed. For streaming we can write into local object store then register

jon (runtime): fallback policy: if prepare slow, route new inferences to older model variant; that's a smart routing policy tie-in

kevin (eng-ml): tests: e2e that simulates partial disk failure + eviction during prepare. timeline assertions: no live manifest with missing shard

maria (ml): warmup-bot: please start a canary spike branch and add perf counters. also create RFC follow-up doc linking design + loader API

warmup-bot: warmup-spike branch created: https://github.com/redwood/warmup-spike (PR #142). CI pipeline triggered :rocket:

samantha (infra): I'll add an integration test to infra/loader-ci to inject eviction events

jon (runtime): next steps: draft minimal API, implement staged rename + manifest atomic patch, run canary in dedicated env

maria (ml): thanks everyone. i'll open the RFC follow-up draft tomorrow and assign reviewers

kevin (eng-ml): 👍

samantha (infra): :thumbsup:
